issues.title: Ambiguous 'Smallest Type' Heuristic for AI
issues.why: AC-15 defines a lookup table as having '≤ 5 columns' and 'one unique TEXT Code', but doesn't specify behavior if a table has 6 columns but is clearly a static enum. A mediocre AI might strictly follow the count and use INTEGER, violating the intent.
issues.fix: Clarify that the 5-column rule is a guideline and the 'migration-only inserts' condition is the primary determinant for SMALLINT.

issues.title: Inconsistent Boolean Type Mapping for MySQL
issues.why: §2.1.1 specifies TINYINT(1) for MySQL, but §01 Rule 1 uses 'BOOLEAN' in the SQL snippet. While MySQL aliases BOOLEAN to TINYINT(1), an AI might be confused about which keyword is 'normative' for DDL generation.
issues.fix: Standardize all MySQL examples to use TINYINT(1) explicitly to match the normative storage table.

issues.title: Truncated View Example
issues.why: The end of 03-orm-and-views.md is truncated due to the context cap, leaving the 'Example — Creating and Using a View' incomplete.
